name: octaweave_presign_upload
description: STEP 1 OF 3 for uploading a file. Returns {upload_id, url, expires_in}. The bytes do NOT go through this tool: you must then PUT the file to `url` yourself with the `bash` tool — `curl -X PUT --upload-file <path> -H 'content-type: <type>' "<url>"` — with no credentials, because the URL is already signed and points at object storage rather than Octaweave. Finally call octaweave_confirm_upload. The URL is valid for 30 minutes. `size` must be the real byte size.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

name.description: File name as it should appear in the drive.

size.description: Exact size of the file in bytes.

content_type.description: MIME type, e.g. 'image/png'. Must match the PUT's content-type header.

folder.description: Optional destination folder id; omit for the root.
